subject: Best fonts for plots and how to use them

messages.author: 1882f09dc744a70d
messages.subject: Best fonts for plots and how to use them
parts:
Hi. Do you have any preferences regarding fonts you use in your plots?
I've tried Ubuntu here http://si14.livejournal.com/18757.html and it
looks nice to me, but there is always something better, I think.
Another question is how to use fonts in ggplot2. I've installed some
fonts like OpenSans in my Ubuntu, added base_family="Ubuntu" to theme,
but when I change "Ubuntu" to "Open Sans", for example, nothing
happens — I get a default font. How can I use OpenSans, for example?

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Best fonts for plots and how to use them
parts:
Try the article on non-standard fonts in this issue of R-news:
http://cran.r-project.org/doc/Rnews/Rnews_2006-2.pdf

Hadley
